hotels.title: Victoria High Country Italian-Inspired Retreat with Wine Tasting & Daily Breakfast Hamper
hotels.description: Escape to this secluded, sustainable sanctuary, a hidden gem cradled within King Valley’s rolling hills and rustic charm. Here, industrial meets idyllic as luxuriously appointed shipping containers transform into designer havens and homesteads, complete with large windows that frame sweeping vineyard views stretching as far as the eye can see. Enjoy a welcome bottle of local wine and discover the estate’s intimate Cellar Door. Meander through family-owned vineyards and find the perfect picnic spot for your daily breakfast hamper, sample award-winning prosecco, or venture further to discover waterfalls and mountain trails. As twilight falls, gather around the firepit while a blanket of stars unfurls above.
